vi: Hiểu dịch vụ global (DNS zone, Front Door) vẫn phải nằm trong Resource Group, khác mô hình AWS.
Khai báo DNS zone authoritative và delegate domain cha sang bốn name server Azure để zone resolve công khai.
Cấu hình A record + TTL hợp lý (low TTL cho failover nhanh, high TTL giảm query) để hostname phân giải.
Dựng Front Door profile (container SKU) + endpoint (điểm vào anycast) làm edge PoP toàn cầu trước origin.
Chọn SKU Front Door (Standard vs Premium), khoá origin chỉ nhận traffic qua Front Door, và dọn bằng RG/Terraform.
en: Understand that global services (DNS zone, Front Door) must still reside in a Resource Group, unlike AWS model.
Declare an authoritative DNS zone and delegate the parent domain to Azure's four name servers for public DNS resolution.
Configure A record + appropriate TTL (low for quick failover, high to reduce queries) for hostname resolution.
Build a Front Door profile (SKU container) + endpoint (anycast entry point) as a global edge PoP in front of origin.
Choose Front Door SKU (Standard vs Premium), lock origin to accept traffic only via Front Door, and clean up via RG/Terraform.
